item.title: [phishing] AI-enabled device code phishing campaign exploits OAuth flow for account takeover
item.description: <p>A phishing campaign that bypasses the standard 15-minute expiration window through automation and dynamic code generation, leveraging the OAuth Device Code Authentication flow to compromise organizational accounts at scale, has been observed by the Microsoft Defender Security Research team. The campaign uses AI-assisted infrastructure and end-to-end automation. Attack overview Device Code Authentication is a legitimate OAuth flow designed for devices that cannot support a standard interactive login.
